summary: All checks pass (build, vet, test, secrets exit 0) and the Revision fast-forwards master, but two correctness gaps in the new live-run surface block merge. (1) Blocking: the per-agent live Run record is written at dispatch and removed only on a graceful return; there is no startup reconciliation. After an unclean termination (SIGKILL/crash/OOM) status keeps publishing a phantom live_runs entry until that agent's next Run overwrites it, violating the documented 'for every in-flight Run' contract and bypassing the existing stale-trigger-state and reserved-residue cleanup in NewScheduler/cleanupReservedResidue. (2) In --json a readLiveRuns error is silently reduced to live_runs: [] with no machine-readable field (unlike trigger_state_error and kernel lock_error), and the human view prints 'live runs: none' despite the live-run-state-unknown warning; the runStatus comment claiming the envelope carries both reasons is now false for the live-run path.
